sources.snippet: Cedar is an open-source engine and language created by AWS. Cedar agent is an OSS project from Permit.io - which provides the ability to run Cedar as a standalone agent (Similar to how one would use OPA) which can then be powered by OPAL. Cedar agent is the easiest way to deploy and run Cedar ...
